name: aad-h1pa

provider_reported.read: account_resources() right after the create, known=True

_reserved: 30 GB x $0.07 x 2 months, booked inside the H1-PA PA2v/PA2 $50 envelope from creation (h1pa_governance.spent) until this record states actual_usd
datacenter_choice: live query 2026-10-24T19:00Z: storage support and L40S stock Low in EU-NL-1, EUR-IS-2, US-MO-1, US-NC-1 (OC-AU-1 and US-TX-4 have L40S but no network volumes; US-IL-1 and US-TX-3 no L40S stock); EUR-IS-2 chosen, no measurement distinguishes the four; the volume locks every PA2v/PA2 session to EUR-IS-2 and the L40S
consumer: H1-PA PA2v and PA2: the durable root <mount>/h1pa -- the four new checkpoints, a training's save points while it runs, the evaluation progress and evidence
retention: all four checkpoints are kept until BOTH the H1-PA independent review and the mixed-calibration study's analysis and review are complete (declared_future_use); then a consumer audit and a migration or retirement proposal go to the maintainer; no AGENTS.md 2.5 automatic retirement before then
retire_by: 2026-12-24 at the end of the reservation, or by the maintainer's lifecycle decision; keeping it past the reservation is booked here first

cost_to_date._provider_observed: logs/budget/provider/runpod_billing_2026-10-25T1512Z.json :: networkvolumes, the 2026-10-24 ($0.0525) and 2026-10-25 ($0.0496, partial day) rows; the provider's volume rows carry no volume id, and am5m373kuq is the account's only network volume since H1's 1980hnh75i was retired on 2026-10-24, so the 2026-10-24 row may still include part of that volume's last day
cost_to_date._run_rate: 30 GB x $0.07/GB-month, billed on the provisioned size, not the bytes on it
cost_to_date.booked: reserved_usd stays the booking until the volume is retired; then actual_usd replaces it

contents_after_pa2.save_points: none: the driver released each training's save points after its checkpoint was persisted and re-identified (units/<unit>/attempts.jsonl :: released)
contents_after_pa2.other: evaluation progress and evidence per unit (bounded by h1pa.json :: storage.bytes.evaluation_per_unit_bound); every unit's evidence is also on the relay and the dev box
contents_after_pa2._basis: the persisted-unit descriptors and the attempt journals; the volume was not re-listed (no pod is running)

consumer_audit.launchers_setups_plans_drivers: none reads them: h1pa_launch stages only E1's packs and the PCA-Original checkpoints from the relay (h1pa.json :: relay_inputs); h1pa_driver writes <mount>/h1pa/<unit>/checkpoint and reads it back only to evaluate the unit it trained; no other script, config or plan names <mount>/h1pa
consumer_audit.analysis: h1pa_analysis reads the six units' evidence only (reports, rows, generation summaries, formal reports), never weights
consumer_audit.declared: the maintainer's independent scientific review (h1pa.json :: retention.new_checkpoints): KEEP until it is complete
consumer_audit.protected_elsewhere: the two PCA-Original checkpoints are E1's, on the relay, not on this volume; never retrained or deleted

declared_future_use.decided_by: maintainer brief 2026-10-26 (Mixed Calibration 2x, section 5): the two D4-Augmented checkpoints are the formal control of the next initialization study; they are not retired for want of a code consumer before that consumer completes
declared_future_use.D4-Augmented-s20260726: FORMAL CONTROL of the mixed-calibration study (logs/stages/stage-0/calibration_volume/plans/mixed_preregistration.json): its evaluation evidence is reused as scored and never regenerated; the weights are the retained control anchor (AGENTS.md 2.5 'explicitly retained anchor') until that study's analysis and the maintainer's review are complete
declared_future_use.D4-Original-s20260726: H1-PA's comparison A/B arm: retained until H1-PA's independent review closes; no declared consumer in the mixed-calibration study
declared_future_use.what_reads_the_weights: nothing in the mixed-calibration design: its decision reads the D4-Augmented rows and generations only (AGENTS.md P8.4: completed and scored, evidence not bytes). Retention is a scientific anchor, not an execution dependency; a later authorized consumer (re-evaluation on a future registered eval set, continued training from D4-Augmented, a diagnostic on the control's weights) mounts the volume in EUR-IS-2 and reads them in place
declared_future_use.mixed_study_use_of_the_volume: if MC2 is granted, its two Mix-Augmented checkpoints are written here beside the four (peak about 24.0 GB during its second training, 14.8 GB after), so treatment and control share one datacenter and GPU class (logs/stages/stage-0/calibration_volume/plans/mixed_application.json)

proposal.status: PROPOSED (revised 2026-10-26 for the declared future use); nothing is deleted or moved before the maintainer decides
proposal.recommended: keep all four in place on am5m373kuq (EUR-IS-2) through both reviews: $2.10/month, already reserved to 2026-12-24 inside H1-PA's booking. If either review is still open on 2026-12-24, book one more month ($2.10) here before that date, by maintainer decision, rather than migrate. After both close: (a) no authorized consumer -> retire the weights under AGENTS.md 2.5 with tombstones carrying the digests above, then delete the volume; (b) an authorized follow-up -> it reads them in place
safe_migration_if_ever_required: only on a maintainer decision, and only to a destination whose free capacity was read from its quota endpoint first: the HF relay's private storage accepted about 2 GB on 2026-10-22 (plans/durability_plan.json) against 9.54 GB here (14.3 GB with the Mix-Augmented pair), and the dev box has 3.8 GB free
one pod in EUR-IS-2 mounting am5m373kuq (the volume cannot be read otherwise), priced and capped like any paid session
sha256 every checkpoint against its unit descriptor before the copy, copy (runpodctl send/receive or the provider's S3-compatible endpoint), and sha256 again at the destination
write a migration record (source, destination, both hashes, sizes, time) and only then delete the volume; a tombstone for anything retired
proposal.not_recommended: migrating now: no consumer needs the bytes elsewhere, a migration costs a pod and a transfer, and no destination with room has been confirmed
